CustomField.description: (Peoplesoft) Enrolled in Next Term should accurately reflect students not enrolled in the target term, excluding students who are: a. Active (Prog_Status = ‘AC’) b. Not applied to graduate (Asu_Stdnt_Profile_Maj_Term.Exp_Grad_Term current term or in the past acad year) c. Not deceased (Srvc_Ind_Cd = ‘S00’) d. Not discontinued or disqualified (Acad_Std_Bot IN (‘DIS’, ‘DSQ’) e. Don’t have a Student Life hold (Srvc_Ind_Cd IN (‘S03’, ‘S53’, ‘S54’, ‘S55’ f. Not in program UGPR (mostly exchange and visiting status) g. Past their enrollment appointment open date (Ps_Appointment_Tbl.Appt_Start_Dt < Sysdate or is null) Visible on the Graduate Student Profile tab; Access granted via PS security role 'Student Profile'.
CustomField.label: Enrolled Next Term
